mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.1% signals the Federal Reserve's effective lower bound policy stance, compressing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in sustained liquidity support.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.1% (as of decision point).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate below 10.0% signals accelerating labor market recovery, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE falls below 10.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad-based consumer and business confidence recovery, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through improved earnings visibility.
failure_condition: The joint rise in RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) during early recovery phases signals manufacturing sector stabilization, reducing recession risks and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO rises and UNRATE remains above 10.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in employment (PAYEMS) above 0.5% indicates strengthening labor market fundamentals, supporting consumer spending and corporate margins, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 (2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, increasing recession probability and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls below 90.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates robust consumer demand and labor market improvement, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: The joint increase in RSAFS and decline in UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During recessions with FEDFUNDS at or below 0.1%, accommodative monetary policy supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as the market prices in policy support.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.1% and UNRATE exceeds 10.0%.
